result:
Round 40 **passes**. All seven checks (R40-1 to R40-7) pass on my own runs in the built Electron app, so `realVerified` is true. I found one low docs bug and nothing critical, high or medium. I did not touch the app source: the repository diff was identical at the start and end of my phase.

**What the round changed:** on 24e9723 (old), every disabled or `aria-disabled` button still changed colour on hover. On A's tree (new), it no longer does, and every enabled button hovers exactly as before.

- **R40-1 file ownership:** only the 5 owned files changed and nothing is untracked. The 42 changed lines match `prototype.diff` exactly. In `docs/bugs/001` only lines 24 and 317 changed.
- **R40-2 CSS:** the built CSS has the 4 `:enabled:not([aria-disabled="true"]):hover` rules and the 4 `:enabled:hover` rules. No `.hover\:bg-brand-hover` rule is left.
- **R40-3 hover, old vs new:**
  - On new, these steps keep their resting colour under hover: H1, H2, H4–H8, H9 and H10 while Applying, and H11 with no file playing.
  - On old, the same steps still change colour, so the cue really existed.
  - The enabled controls (H0, H3, H3b, H6b, H7b, H9 and H10 at rest, the enabled play button, the Back arrow and Open Folder) change on hover with exactly the old values.
  - At rest, every colour, opacity (0.5 / 0.6 / 0.3), cursor, `aria-disabled` and `aria-busy` value is the same on old and new. No page errors.
  - The arrow at the end of the list no longer changes colour on hover, which the task intended.
- **R40-4 keyboard save:** the save sent exactly one `meta:write`, and focus stayed on the button during and after it. ffprobe and music-metadata both read `ICAT=C40Keyb`. The other two files' sha256 did not change.
- **R40-5 mutants:** I undid each of the 6 class edits on a copy, one at a time. Each one brought the hover back on its own step only, and the copy was restored afterwards. A grep confirms the expected survivors: only two primary buttons use `aria-disabled`, Rescan is the only natively disabled `Button`, and accent and destructive are not used anywhere.
- **R40-6 gate:** from a clean state the full `verifyCommand` exits 0. Biome shows 0 errors and the same 8 warnings as round 35. Type checks pass, and tests are 310/310 renderer, 93/93 main and 7/7 E2E, also 7/7 with `--retries=0`.
- **R40-7 references and deviations:** I fetched Bootstrap and the Tailwind docs today and both still say what the task quotes.
  - The `not-allowed` cursor still shows on hover, and the reorder arrow cursor is `default`.
  - The Back arrow still changes colour on hover.
  - Lines 24 and 317 now point to `button.tsx:36`, which is the `aria-disabled:` line.
  - For the focus ring on a focused, disabled Save Tags, the computed styles show it is there, but it is hard to see in the screenshot because the button is at 50% opacity. Old looks the same, so it is not caused by this round.

**Bug C-R40-01 (low, docs):** line 376 of `docs/design/component-specs.md` still documents the hidden-field chip with plain `hover:`, but the code now uses `enabled:hover:`. A could not fix it, because R40-1 allowed only the 42 lines of `prototype.diff`. That SchemaEditor section of the spec was already out of date before this round.

**Notes for B (not bugs in this round):**
- D-46 is named in the docs but has no entry in the decision log yet.
- ffprobe shows an empty `IKEY` tag after a save. The code that writes metadata is identical to 24e9723, so this behaviour is older than this round. B may want to check it against the ffprobe field contract with the import tool.
